verdict.reason: All four trace lines (notes.py:8, 43, 44, 45) match the candidate's descriptions, but the only actor who can reach the append is the note owner (require_edit at notes.py:44 → notes.py:20-22), who already has full edit control of that note, and the appended value only affects that same note's can_view result (notes.py:8), so there is no privilege escalation or cross-user impact.
